protocol.claim_boundary: fresh external decoder-tracking confirmation only; Demian weights, architecture, encoder and recurrent dynamics remain fixed
protocol.decision_rule: Confirmation requires true-label orthogonal_track R2 greater than both controls in every one of four seed by three projection cells at each of delay2 and delay8. Identity and scalar-scale rows are descriptive controls. Projections and delays are dependent within seed.
protocol.falsifier: Any primary cell at either delay fails either control comparison; report mixed or failed declared tracking criterion without inferring information erasure.
protocol.fitting_rule: Fit cue6 readout, standardization and cue6-to-delay transforms only on base-order train32 histories. Apply the frozen objects to base-order eval32 and heldout-order eval32. Do not fit any object using heldout-order or evaluation states.
protocol.primary_measurement: orthogonal_track frozen cue6 readout versus analytic latest-cue and matched conditional-label-shuffle controls on within-order eval32
protocol.secondary_measurement: same base-trained frozen objects on heldout-order eval32; reliability-order changes may change the public evidence target, so this does not isolate geometry alone
